name: murphy-baseline
description: Bundled offline hardening library — loaded with no network in offline mode.

rules.title: /tmp carries the sticky bit
rules.rationale: Without the sticky bit any local user can delete or replace another user's files in /tmp.

rules.title: telnet client absent
rules.rationale: The telnet client speaks cleartext; its presence invites cleartext credential use.
rules.fix: Remove the telnet client and use ssh instead.

rules.title: legacy r-services client absent
rules.rationale: rsh/rlogin trust host-based auth and send data in the clear — a classic lateral-movement aid.

rules.title: Yama ptrace_scope is restricted
rules.rationale: Unrestricted ptrace lets a compromised process read secrets straight out of its siblings.

rules.title: perf_event_paranoid is locked down
rules.rationale: Loose perf access has repeatedly been a local info-leak and privesc primitive.

rules.title: /etc/crontab is root-only
rules.rationale: A writable crontab is a direct path to scheduled root code execution.
